items.head: Pilotage

items.head: Caution
items.quote: Anchorage is prohibited within 0.25 mile of either side of these cables. It is worth noting that the coastline from the mouth of the Berbice River to the Courantyne River is low with mud flats and has recorded depths of less than 5.5m from the coast to at least 5.2nm o ffshore. T he coast trends ESE approx 6.9nm and then SSE for 19nm and soundings are the best guide for this stretch of the coast as it is deemed that the charts are not very accurate.

items.head: Regulations
items.quote: Vessels alongside must have their main engines ready at all times so that they can unberth at short notice. No repairs are permitted which would interfere with this requirement.

items.head: Pilotage
